The year '''1041 BBY before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''' was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that occurred during the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Events==
*The [[Krevaaki]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saaj Calician]] first met [[Dromika]] and [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]], the children of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Chagras]]. Calician recognized that the children had the potential to achieve great power and he later became their guardian, after Chagras [[Death/Legends|passed away]] in [[1040 BBY]].

*[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] {{Imo}}
